newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley shuffles research team.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley shuffles research team.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said its director of equity research in North America Philip Friedman will step aside to handle stock selection at the firm's asset management division.
The firm said Friedman will join the Morgan Stanley Asset Management group as a senior member of the domestic equity growth team, effective March 15.
In his new post, Friedman will report to Managing Director Kurt Feuerman and take a direct role in stock selection across a variety of industry groups, the firm said.
Dennis Shea will succeed Friedman as Morgan Stanley's North American director of research in its equity research division. Shea was formerly the U.S. equity research regional banking analyst.

In addition, the firm said David Hilder was named U.S. regional banking analyst. Hilder, who formerly covered specialty finance companies, will be replaced in that capacity by Jennifer Oliver-Martin, the firm said.
